notes: No acceptance.json preserves the prior completed no-application-change audit behavior.

Application repair base is fixed to ec19554. Approved commits must have one parent and be ordered for patch application. Replaying only their application patches in a temporary index must match applicationFixRef.
Application bytes, tracked additions/deletions, untracked files, symbolic links and executable modes are checked against applicationFixRef.
Fixed cases must be ordinary tests in the current inventory/reconciliation, have a matching current suite/report/source receipt, and kill an actual post-repair fault. Inverse probes do not qualify.
Open/deferred cases must remain it.fails and have exact ordinary failed observations. They do not require temporary repairs and cannot populate a PROTECTED feature row.
With acceptance active, all changed/new ordinary case proofs require actual fault-injection pass/fail/pass; historical inverse probes cannot satisfy a renamed or partially repaired ordinary case.
